description:
Adds bamboo which generates in jungles and can be used as a crafting ingredient.

Adds bamboo as well as a few others blocks.

To get bamboo, go to a jungle and find it naturally growing.

Bamboo can be crafted into bamboo bundles for decoration or storage by placing nine bamboo sticks in the crafting grid. This recipe is reversible.

Bamboo can be made into dry bamboo by placing it on a non-dirt block and waiting for it to die.

Dry bamboo can be used as a fuel in a furnace.

Dry bamboo can be used to make sticks and dry bamboo bundles.

All of these blocks make nice decorations.

This mod uses the same technical name as these mods and can be used as a drop-in replacement.

https://forum.minetest.net/viewtopic.php?id=4542

https://content.luanti.org/packages/runs/cool_trees/ (only the bamboo mod)

(This mod uses entirely original code and assets.)
